t.name: Coleman Weedpatch Trail #121
t.description: Trail #121 starts on Forest Road 2160 a few miles before Walupt Lake Campground at the Coleman Weedpatch Trailhead. The trail heads south along the border of Goat Rocks Wilderness through dense second growth conifers and ends on the Pacific Crest Trail.

t.name: Walupt Lake Trail #101
t.description: Beginning in the Walupt Lake Campground, the trail follows the lakeshore until reaching Walupt Creek. At the end of the lake the trail climbs into an open alpine area before meeting the Pacific Crest Trail.

t.name: Nannie Ridge Trail #98
t.description: The trail branches off Walupt Lake Trail #101 a short distance from the campground and climbs steeply northeast onto an open, scenic ridgetop within Goat Rocks Wilderness. The trail follows the ridge, ending on the Pacific Crest Trail near Sheep Lake.

t.name: Lily Basin Trail #86
t.description: This trail provides access to the Goat Rocks Wilderness. Views of Packwood Lake and Mt. Rainier are available from this trail. Parts of this trail may have been a Native American travel route, used by mountain goat hunters.

t.name: Bypass Trail #97
t.description: Connects the Snowgrass Trail with the Pacific Crest Trail to the south. This trail was also part of the original Klickitat Trail.

t.name: Goat Ridge Trail #95
t.description: The trail climbs steeply up Goat Ridge to a junction with the Lily Basin Trail.

t.name: Snowgrass Trail #96
t.description: The trail is a major entry point to the Goat Rocks Wilderness following the Goat Creek drainage and climbing up to a junction with the Pacific Crest Trail.

t.name: Muddy Meadows Trail #13
t.description: The Muddy Meadows trail leads into the Mount Adams Wilderness. Running through forested areas and crossing meadows it connects with the Pacific Crest Trail and ends at the High Line Trail.

t.name: Highline Trail #114
t.description: The Highline trail traveverses the north side of Mt. Adams within Mt. Adams Wilderness and rises in elevation to nearly 7,800'. The trail features spectacular views of Lyman and Lava Glaciers, as well as panoramic views of the Goat Rocks and Mt. Rainier.
